pr.title: BRC CLI + orchestrator enforce minimum rationale content
pr.description:
Closes the CLI/protocol asymmetry that let ACKs carry empty bodies. Adds
`--reason` (required) to `egg-orch consensus ack`, extends `propose`
with `--commit`, `--files-changed`, `--tests-run`, `--tasks`, and
enforces a minimum-content floor in the orchestrator for the four BRC
signal handlers (propose, ack, nack, withdraw). Updates the producer
and reviewer lifecycle text so agents learn the new contract. Closes
#1716.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: new tests under `sandbox/tests/` for CLI argparse + payload
  construction, and under `orchestrator/tests/` for `_validate_brc_content`
  and each BRC handler's 400-on-empty / 200-on-valid behavior (including
  the re-propose path).
- Manual: run a small concurrent-mode pipeline, confirm `egg-orch
  consensus ack` without `--reason` fails argparse, confirm a 49-char
  reason returns 400 from the orchestrator with an actionable message,
  and confirm a substantive ACK body appears in the message store.
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: none.
Post-merge: none. The new prompt+CLI ship together so new pipelines pick
up the change atomically; no stateful migration needed.
